title: Association of Regulatory Affairs professionals (ARAP) in collaboration with Indian Pharmaceutical Association (IPA) Delhi organised 2nd Indian Regulatory and Quality Summit 2021 on 23rd March 2021 in New Delhi.
bodyHtml: Association of Regulatory Affairs professionals (ARAP) in collaboration with Indian Pharmaceutical Association (IPA) Delhi organised 2nd Indian Regulatory and Quality Summit 2021 on 23rd March 2021 in New Delhi. This summit was inaugurated by Dr. Rajeev Singh Raghuvanshi, Secretary-cum-Scientific Director-IPC, Dr. Anup Anvikar, Director-NIB, and Prof. Rup Khar. On this occasion, Dr. Raghuvanshi was the Guest of Honour and delivered a talk on the role of IPC in strengthening the quality management systems for drugs in India and suggested that the drug regulation mechanism in the country may be improved by cooperation among the different organizations working in similar areas with other mandates. During the summit, IPC also displayed their products (IP, NFI, Guidance Documents etc.) before the participants.
